scripts.build: pnpm run build:ui && pnpm run build:docs
scripts.ci:publish: pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-ui-qcalendar publish --access public --publish-branch dev && pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-app-extension-qcalendar publish --access public --publish-branch dev
scripts.ci:publish:beta: pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-ui-qcalendar publish --access public --publish-branch v5-beta --tag beta && pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-app-extension-qcalendar publish --access public --publish-branch v5-beta --tag beta
scripts.verify:fast: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm test
